title: LangChain Tutorial: From Prompts to RAG and AI Agents
description: Learn LangChain in Python step by step. This hands-on LangChain tutorial covers chat models, prompt templates, LCEL chains, RAG, and tool-calling agents.
summary: LangChain is a framework for Python and JavaScript that lets you build applications powered by large language models (LLMs). Sending a single prompt to a model takes only a couple of lines of code.
takeaways: You’ll receive a score upon completion to help you track your learning progress: Interactive Quiz LangChain Tutorial: From Prompts to RAG and AI Agents Check your grasp of LangChain in Python, from chat messages and prompt templates to LCEL chains, RAG retrieval, and tool-calling agents.
Along the way, you’ll cover chat models, prompt templates, chains, retrieval, and agents.
You don’t need any prior experience with LLMs, but a basic understanding of embeddings and vector databases will help in the RAG section.
